class.name: NNSTRoot
class.brief_description: Root node that owns and ticks a State Tree.
class.description: Entry point for a hierarchical state tree. Add [NNSTNode] and [NNSTParallel] children to define states, optional [NNSensors] children for utility-based state selection, and optional fallback [NNSTTransition] children for root-level event handling. By default the root enters its initial state on ready and ticks automatically on physics frames according to [member process_thread] and [member tick_rate]. Set [member process_thread] to [constant MANUAL] to tick it yourself with [method tick], or nest it under a state, agent action, [NNBTRunHostedRoot], or HTN task to let that host drive it. Provides the [NNBlackboard] (also storing expression properties for [NNSTExpressionGuard]) and actor context for all states below it, and emits [signal finished] when entering a state marked [member NNSTTickedNodes.is_final].

constants.constant: Ticks automatically on physics frames. This is the default.
Disables automatic ticking so your own code can call [method tick] or [method auto_tick_step].
Triggered by a matching event sent with [method NNSTBranchNodes.send_event].
Triggered automatically when the parent state is entered.
Triggered automatically when an expression property changes (used by [NNSTExpressionGuard]).
Triggered automatically when active states change (used by [NNSTStateIsActiveGuard]).

method.name: auto_tick_step
method.description: Runs one scheduled step using the same enabled checks and [member tick_rate] throttle as automatic ticking. Returns [code]true[/code] if the chart ticked. Useful for custom schedulers and deterministic tests.

method.name: get_child_sensors
method.description: Returns the direct child [NNSensors] nodes attached to this root.

method.name: tick
method.description: Updates child sensors and ticks all active states top-down with [param delta]. If no states are currently active, enters the initial state first.

method.name: set_expression_property
method.description: Writes a named property to the blackboard and notifies [NNSTExpressionGuard] transitions to re-evaluate.

method.name: get_expression_property
method.description: Returns the value of an expression property from the blackboard, or [param default] if unset.

members.member: Optional actor [Node] this state tree acts for. When unset, [method NoodleNodes.get_actor] inherits from the nearest ancestor root or falls back to this node's parent.
Optional [NNBlackboard] resource for this state tree (also used for expression properties). When unset, inherits from the nearest ancestor root or creates a private blackboard automatically.
Initial expression properties written to the blackboard before the first state is entered.
Controls when the state tree ticks automatically ([constant PHYSICS], [constant IDLE], or [constant MANUAL]). Ignored when hosted under another AI node.
Ticks every [code]N[/code]th frame (default [code]1[/code], every frame), passing the accumulated delta since the previous tick. Ignored when hosted under another AI node.
Duration in microseconds of the last [method tick] call (debug builds only).

signal.name: event_received
signal.description: Emitted when an event is dispatched to this root before being delivered to active states.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Emitted with [param succeeded] set to [code]true[/code] when a state with [member NNSTTickedNodes.is_final] is entered.
